text:
Nina (People Ops): Quick heads-up 1-cycle logistics + a short manager training session next week. Please skim and react.

Nina (People Ops): Core dates: self-reviews Apr 4-9; manager writeups Apr 16 COB; calibration panels Apr 19-23. Final sign-off Apr 30.

Omar (eng-manager): Where do we register for panels?

Nina (People Ops): RSVP form -> https://go.redwood/hr/register-panels. Pick a preferred slot and add delegate if needed.

Vera (engineer): Are there manager training resources? New managers on my team asked.

Nina (People Ops): Yes1-hour manager training (panel etiquette + rubric walk-through) on Apr 12 at 10am. Recording will be posted. Materials: short_prep.pdf and rubric_v2_notes.md.

Leo (manager): For calibration panels, what evidence is expected?

Sam (hr-ops): Max 3 artifacts per report: PR links, dashboard snapshots, short 1-paragraph impact statement. No large files.

Omar (eng-manager): How will normalization work across panels?

Nina (People Ops): Each panel uses rubric_v2 with normalization factors applied at cluster level. If a manager disagrees with adjusted scores, there9s a 48h clarification window (factual items only).

hr-bot: Reminder: managers who haven't RSVP'd will receive an automated DM 72h before panels start.

Leo (manager): If a promotion is on the table, is that handled in panels?

Sam (hr-ops): Promotions need a short promotion packet submitted to hr-promo@redwood before your panel; promotions trigger a separate 30-min review.

Vera (engineer): Thanks helps to have the timeline.

Nina (People Ops): Action items: managers RSVP by Apr 8, submit prep template by Apr 13, upload artifacts by Apr 13. Ping me or @Sam with access issues. :calendar:
